title: How to Install Cognotik Desktop on Windows
overview: A walkthrough demo video showing how to download, install, configure, and test Cognotik Desktop on Windows. Covers downloading the installer from cognotic.com, running the installer, launching the server-based application, creating a local login, adding an Anthropic API key, and verifying the setup with a basic chat test.
